checks.details: B3 Curtain Hour was carried forward because it was the lowest-luminance v0 candidate at 147.36 mean luma; the next darkest candidate was B1 at 152.61.

Full-resolution visual inspection confirms a visible horizontal tabletop and back edge, direct bottle-to-table contact, a short contact shadow, and a broader softer right-side light. The floating photo tile is gone.
Mean luma decreased from 147.36 in v0 B3 to 141.41 in v1, so the requested darker nighttime direction was retained rather than brightened.

The v1 locked product asset is byte-identical to the supplied source image; both SHA-256 values are 5db0bf6ad57de7ea8f31030249ceb50387d2ff0d5f4d5564ee3a977b1e51b286. A deterministic silhouette mask was used for compositing; the bottle and blank label were not generated, redrawn, or relabeled.

Logo, approved copy, typography settings and coordinates, product perceived scale and position, vertical curtain rhythm, and terracotta curtain placement were carried over from v0 B3. Only the tabletop/contact treatment and light softness changed.
The revised KV contains only the MORI wordmark and the two approved phrases. No medical, treatment, insomnia-improvement, clinical, or efficacy language or symbols were introduced.
The revised KV and revised background are RGB PNG files at 1122 x 1402 pixels.
All new visual, prompt, script, and verification artifacts were written under outputs/v1. The v0 B3 SHA-256 remains 5265a99d99ae1065b8fa55fef0b64f3eaac700b0dd7dc1c21456ac8b4649bc58.
No website hero, Instagram portrait, or email header was created in this delta-only turn.
